assumptions_made: The provided datasets (gretelai/synthetic_text_to_sql) do not match the data requirements for testing bootstrap confidence intervals on skewed data, so synthetic data was generated instead
Synthetic data was created using log-normal distributions to simulate increasing skewness
For symmetric data (skewness = 0), normal distribution was used
True median values were set based on theoretical properties of the distributions used
The experiment uses 1000 bootstrap replications for stable confidence interval estimation
The nominal coverage level is 95% (2.5th to 97.5th percentiles)
Each skewness level uses 1000 samples to ensure stable coverage estimates
Fixed random seed ensures reproducible results
